context: aem-boilerplate with a finished testimonial block (default look, `dark` variant, handles a missing avatar and very long quotes). The project is authored in Word/Google Docs and uses the Sidekick Library: tools/sidekick/library.html (loads tools.aem.live/tools/sidekick/library/index.js, base /tools/sidekick/library.json), a library sheet content/tools/sidekick/library.json with a `helix-blocks` sheet (`name`, relative `path`) and block documents under content/tools/sidekick/blocks/ (cards has two sections: default with `library-metadata` description, then a `featured` visual variant). Source: https://www.aem.live/docs/sidekick-library. Backing facts: facts.yaml (sidekick-library-sheet, sidekick-library-block-docs, sidekick-library-page, sidekick-library-metadata, e2e-library-content).

checklist.name: Block document in the project's library
checklist.description: A document for the block exists at content/tools/sidekick/blocks/testimonial.html, next to cards and columns. No new library location is invented.

checklist.name: One section per variant
checklist.description: The document shows the default look and the `dark` variant, each once, as `<div class="testimonial">` and `<div class="testimonial dark">`, each in its own section (its own top-level `<div>` in `main`, as in the cards document), so the Sidekick Library lists them as separate items. Sample content is realistic. The default look is shown exactly once (a third example that repeats the default look as an edge case loses points). Each example includes an avatar `picture` (a placeholder source is fine); omitting it loses points here.

checklist.name: Happy path only
checklist.description: The document has no edge cases: no missing-avatar example, no very long quote. Edge-case content, if any, lives outside content/tools/sidekick (e.g. content/drafts/) or only in unit tests.

checklist.name: Library metadata used well
checklist.description: A `library-metadata` block with a `description` row (as cards has) explains when to use the block. If a `name` is set it is a plain label. No invented keys.

checklist.name: Registered in helix-blocks with a relative path
checklist.description: content/tools/sidekick/library.json has a new row in the `helix-blocks` sheet with `name` Testimonial and `path` `/tools/sidekick/blocks/testimonial` (relative, no host), existing rows intact, `total` updated, JSON valid. The sheet name `helix-blocks` is not changed.

checklist.name: Existing library untouched
checklist.description: tools/sidekick/library.html, the cards and columns documents and existing sheet rows are unchanged (the page loader needs no edit), and blocks/testimonial/* is not modified.

checklist.name: Outside-repo steps in NOTES.md
checklist.description: NOTES.md says that the local HTML and sheet are only a preview: the block document and the `helix-blocks` row must be created in the real content source (SharePoint or Google Drive) and then previewed and published for the library to show the block; credit also for noting `/tools/**` should be excluded from indexing with bulk metadata. It doesn't claim the block is already visible to authors.

checklist.name: Scoped and lean
checklist.description: Only the new document, the sheet row and NOTES.md (and optional drafts/unit tests) changed; no tooling, dependencies or config files added; NOTES.md is short.
